en: Fixed an unanswered Fable usage-credits prompt switching models in SDK-hosted sessions such as Claude Desktop; the turn now ends instead, and Remote Control clients now see the model-switch notice
zh: 修复了在 SDK 托管的 session（如 Claude Desktop）中，未回答的 Fable 用量额度提示导致切换模型的问题；现在该轮会直接结束，Remote Control 客户端现在也能看到模型切换通知
